content.prompt:
Sam is on holiday in Lyndoch and wants to visit a few nearby towns.

If the numbers represent the distance between towns in kilometres, what is the distance of the path that starts at Lyndoch, travels through each town once and ends at Angaston?

answer.worked:
Truro connects only to Tanunda and Angaston. The path ends at Angaston, so it must run Tanunda → Truro → Angaston. Starting at Lyndoch, the only way to reach Tanunda while visiting Nuriootpa first is Lyndoch → Nuriootpa → Tanunda.

The path is Lyndoch → Nuriootpa → Tanunda → Truro → Angaston.

$$\begin{aligned}\text{Distance}&=9+7+15+11\\&=42\text{ km}\end{aligned}$$
